---
description: General coding rules applied to all files.
applyTo: '**'
---

- Prefer clarity over cleverness; keep functions small and single-purpose.
- Name things for what they are; avoid abbreviations.
- Validate input only at system boundaries.
- Do not leave dead code, commented-out code, or debug output.
- Comments state only what the code cannot show; one short line.
- Never hard-code secrets, tokens, or credentials.
